r: Fought **108 battles in 12 years** against the Rashtrakutas (**Govinda III, Amoghavarsha I**) and their Gangavadi allies
**Narendreswara / Narendra Mrigeswara**, at the battle sites
The **Sataluru** inscription (Kopparam is a Pulakesin II record)
**Birudankaprolu = Bikkavolu** (East Godavari), after Gunaga Vijayaditya's title **Birudankabhima**
**Gunaga Vijayaditya III** (848-892) – **Golingeswara, Rajarajeswara (Raja Raja), Chandrasekhara, Mukteswara, Vijayeswara**
Built by Gunaga Vijayaditya III, not **Rajaraja Narendra**
The Rajahmundry **Vishnu temple**, made a mosque under the **Tughlaqs**

The **Draksharama Bhimeswara** temple – blends **Pallava + early Chalukya** features into an independent style
Ramakonda cave for guru Trikala Yogi Siddhanta Deva
Grant at the request of Chamekamba

Said to have built **360 temples** – "the Vengi ruler who built many temples"; built the **Pancharamas**
Founded by him – the **Bhimeswara** temple, an **Eastern Chalukya** monument
**Draksharama Bhimeswara** and **Kumararama Bhimeswara at Samalkot**, the latter in memory of his **son**

A Narasimha shrine, not a Pancharama

0.x: **Sapta Godavari:** the sacred tank (**pushkarini**) of the **Draksharama Bhimeswara** temple; legend says the Seven Sages brought its water, used for the abhisheka.
**Jananathapura:** Draksharama was also the provincial capital and coronation seat of the Chalukya-Chola viceroys of Vengi.
